subs.label: Methodology
subs.desc: DRIVE is a structured, iterative methodology for rolling out data analytics across an enterprise deployment.

label: Data Connections, Joins & Files
desc: 8 interview questions covering Joins, Connections, Blending, Files.

subs.label: Joins
subs.desc: What are the different types of joins in Tableau?

subs.label: Connections
subs.desc: What are the different connection types you can make with a dataset? What is the difference between published and embedded data sources in Tableau?

subs.label: Blending
subs.desc: Data blending lets you view and analyze data from multiple data sources in one place.

subs.label: Files
subs.desc: A .tde (Tableau Data Extract) file points to data pulled from an external source such as Excel, Access, or CSV files.

label: Data Modeling & Calculations
desc: 12 interview questions covering Parameters, Data Modeling, Sets, Groups and more.

subs.label: Parameters
subs.desc: A parameter is a variable — a number, string, or date — created to replace a constant value used in a calculation, filter, or reference line.

subs.label: Data Modeling
subs.desc: When you connect a new data source, every field is mapped as either a measure or a dimension, each with a data type (integer, string, and so on) and a role (discrete dimension or continuous measure).

subs.label: Sets
subs.desc: Sets are custom fields that define a subset of data in your workbook.

subs.label: Groups
subs.desc: Groups combine related members of a dimension into a larger category for analysis.

subs.label: Filters
subs.desc: What are the various types of filters in Tableau?

subs.label: Calculated Fields
subs.desc: A calculated field is a new field derived via a formula built on top of other fields — it doesn't exist in the source data until you define it.

subs.label: Functions
subs.desc: What is the Rank function in Tableau?

label: Visualization, Dashboards & Performance

subs.label: Visualization
subs.desc: What are dual axes? What is the difference between a treemap and a heat map?

subs.label: Dashboards
subs.desc: What components make up a dashboard? What is a story in Tableau?

subs.label: Publishing
subs.desc: How do you embed views into webpages?

subs.label: Performance
subs.desc: The Tableau data engine is an analytical database that computes near-instant query responses and handles predictive analysis and integrated data.

subs.label: Administration
subs.desc: What are extracts and schedules in Tableau Server? How do you generally perform load testing in Tableau?
